questions.prompt: Where should the server configuration go?
questions.why: by serve --config reads it. It holds token hashes only; tokens go into 0600 files beside it.

choices.label: In the repository
choices.description: reviewable; its tokens/ directory is git-ignored

questions.prompt: Which address should the server listen on?
questions.why: Plain HTTP is refused off loopback; any other address needs TLS.

choices.label: Loopback
choices.description: this machine only; no TLS needed

choices.label: All interfaces
choices.description: reachable from the network; needs a certificate

questions.prompt: Where should branch state and operations be kept?
questions.why: SQLite needs nothing; PostgreSQL lets several servers and workers share the queue.

choices.label: SQLite
choices.description: in the data directory; one server

choices.label: PostgreSQL
choices.description: docker found (the deploy topic runs PostgreSQL in compose); several servers can share it

questions.why: Each tenant gets its own credential, repository reach and quotas; requests never choose their tenant.

choices.label: Just me
choices.description: one admin credential in the default tenant

choices.label: Several teams
choices.description: one credential and quota per tenant
